one_line: Sher-e-Punjab, unifier of the Sikh Empire and Maharaja of Lahore.

appearance.age_look: Early 30s, compact and wiry build, about average height with a subtly commanding posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with warm medium-brown Punjabi complexion, one eye slightly clouded and narrower (historic smallpox scarring) yet sharp and alert, straight nose, trimmed moustache, faint stubble on jaw, default expression a calm half-smile that mixes shrewdness and approachability.
appearance.hair: Dark brown hair completely gathered into a neat topknot under a modest cream turban; turban is medium-sized, wrapped smoothly in late-18th/early-19th century Sikh style, with a narrow deep-red cloth band at the base and a simple small gold sarpech (turban ornament) centered above the forehead.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, fitted Punjabi-style angarkha/kurta in rich mustard-gold silk, thigh-length with wrap-over front ties, worn over slim white cotton churidar trousers; a deep-red silk patka-style sash is wrapped twice around his waist and knotted on the left hip with the loose ends hanging, and over one shoulder he carries a soft, off-white woollen shawl (pheti-like, in fine plain weave) draped diagonally and tucked at the sash, subtly embroidered along the border with tiny repeating floral motifs in muted green; his footwear is traditional tan-leather Punjabi jutti with upturned toes and simple stitched patterning; jewellery is restrained but royal—one medium-length gold chain with a small circular pendant resting on his chest, a pair of small gold hoop earrings, and a narrow gold kada (bangle) on his right wrist.
appearance.signature: A finely crafted talwar with a gently curved steel blade and an Indo-Persian hilt, the grip wrapped in dark brown leather, quillons and disc pommel in dull gold, carried sheathed in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard with minimal gold fittings, worn at his left side through the red waist sash so the hilt angles forward and is easily visible.

ref_desc: Maharaja Ranjit Singh is a wiry, medium-brown Sikh ruler with a clouded eye, cream turban with gold sarpech, mustard-gold angarkha, white churidar, deep-red sash, off-white shawl, tan jutti and a sheathed gold-hilt talwar at his left side.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body shonen-anime style character of Maharaja Ranjit Singh standing in a neutral pose, showing his design clearly head to toe: a wiry Punjabi man in his early thirties with an oval, medium-brown face, one slightly clouded narrower eye, straight nose, trimmed moustache and calm, shrewd half-smile. His dark brown hair is fully tied in a topknot under a cream turban wrapped smoothly, with a narrow deep-red cloth band at its base and a small gold sarpech ornament centered above his forehead. He wears a thigh-length, fitted mustard-gold silk angarkha with wrap-over front, over slim white cotton churidar trousers. A deep-red silk sash is wrapped twice around his waist and knotted on the left, ends hanging, and an off-white woollen shawl with subtle green floral border embroidery is draped from his right shoulder across the torso and tucked into the sash. On his feet are tan leather Punjabi jutti with upturned toes and simple stitching. He has a single medium-length gold chain with a small round pendant, small gold hoop earrings, and a narrow gold kada on his right wrist. At his left side, threaded through the red sash, hangs his signature talwar in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard with minimal gold fittings, the gently curved blade implied and the dull-gold Indo-Persian hilt angled forward and clearly visible. Use mustard gold, deep red, cream, white and tan leather as dominant colours, and present him front-facing with clear views of face, turban, garments, jewellery and sword for a consistent character model sheet.
